evidence.trustReason: Trust rejected. Tests run: bun test --timeout 60000 test/task/harness.test.ts -> 7 pass, 0 fail, 28 expects, exit 0 (3 runs). Implementation reads correct; the gaps are in what the assertions prove. GAP TC1 (Happy Path, SV8 busy { runID, spec, path }): both claims use the same spec and path and spec === path ('task-formats/blend/release-notes.spec'), so the busy and live assertions prove only runID; a busy that echoes the requester's spec/path, or a mapping that swaps spec and path, passes unchanged. SV8 requires the live run's spec and path. Fix: distinct spec/path per claim and spec !== path. GAP TC2 (Error Propagation): the withClaim test never observes the claim as held (no live = Some inside start), so a withClaim that never claims passes; no case shows a successful start keeps the lease, so a withClaim that releases on every exit passes all 7 tests (a second /task could start beside a live run). Fix: assert live inside start, add a success case that stays busy. Covered: TC3 SV13 session index (claim, replace, removeRun drops task_a entries, keeps task_z); TC4 forwarding to one directory's supervisor (outside/external record rule deferred to T2.10 by the task's own SV20 case); TC5 running <-> system.get run:<runID>, id formats; TC6 checkout lock serialises two merges (git lock only not.toBe(checkout), weak); TC8 SV20 forward T9 to run:<runID>; TC9 /repo, /repo/, symlink one lease, non-holder release (isSome only, weak). TC7 N/A. Notes: journal/task/T2.5-verify.md.
